sentences.text: No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioner even in the second round.

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner-complainant with the limited prayer that the Investigating Agency may be directed to conduct fair and impartial investigation in FIR No.331/2022 registered at Police Station Pachpadara, Distt. Barmer for offence under Sections 450, 376(2)
(i) of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of POCSO Act.

Learned Public Prosecutor submits that the Investigating agency is already conducting free and fair investigation, however, if any material is brought on record by the petitioner the same (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-105/2023] shall be considered by the prosecution strictly in accordance with law before completing the investigation.
Taking into account all the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner is directed to submit a detailed representation before the concerned Superintendent of Police as well as the Investigating Officer within a period of fifteen days from today, who shall take up all the facts as well as Sayari vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61776052/
1 contentions raised in the representation and complete the investigation by considering them strictly in accordance with law.
The instant misc. petition is disposed of accordingly.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 28-NK/-
